name: io.github.ohneben/hubspot-mcp
title: HubSpot
description: HubSpot API: 1,000+ endpoints as safety-categorized, hub- and plan-aware MCP tools, stdio or HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Server transport. Set to 'stdio' for local MCP clients; the image otherwise starts the Streamable HTTP transport.

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HubSpot service key or legacy private app token (pat-...), from Settings -> Integrations. An OAuth access token also works.

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API host. Default https://api.hubapi.com; use https://api-eu1.hubapi.com for EU data residency portals.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Only for MCP_TRANSPORT=http: bearer token required on /mcp. Without it a non-loopback bind refuses to start.
